Name: Train Station
Author: CherryChain
Description:
[b][size=4][color=Red]⚠[/color] This mod is deprecated. It'll be kept updated to support older content packs, but newer mods should use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url] instead.[/size][/b]

This mods adds a ticket machine at the railroad, which lets you travel to train stations added by other mod authors for a fee. This creates a connected travel network to travel throughout the world.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use (for players)[/size][/b]
Walk to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Railroad]the railroad[/url] and interact with the ticket machine to buy tickets. For boat destinations, unlock [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fish_Shop#Willy.27s_Boat]Willy's boat[/url] and then interact with the ticket machine there.

If it says "No destinations available", make sure you installed a content pack that adds a railroad destination (and that it's been unlocked if it's conditional).


[b][size=5]How to use (for mod authors)[/size][/b]
There are two steps to add a train station:
[list=1]
[*]Add a ticket machine to open the train menu by adding a tile property to the map.
[*]Add a destination to the train menu by creating a content pack.
[/list]See the [url=https://github.com/ChroniclerCherry/stardew-valley-mods/tree/develop/TrainStation#readme]technical documentation[/url] for more info. There's an example content pack on the Files tab (under optional downloads).


[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
Some mods may change the layout of the railroad location, so the ticket machine and disembark position are somewhere they shouldn't be. You can fix it by opening this mod's [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file in a text editor, and changing the [font=Courier New]TicketStationX[/font], [font=Courier New]TicketStationY[/font], [font=Courier New]RailroadWarpX[/font], and [font=Courier New]RailroadWarpY[/font] fields. You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url] to see tile positions in-game.

Otherwise there are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no changes to your save.[/quote]
